title: Flashing
note: devlab flash did its first real flash (2026-11-10): the pristine stock image, the manifest's fixes baked in, the device tree fingerprinted (a43d069d0a49adcd), the phone back with all 20 checks passing.

title: Health, after every boot
note: devlab test, health, watch: regressions raise one board task.

title: The lab's ear
note: devlab hear, proven on surya (2026-11-10): a 1000 Hz tone on each speaker, heard through a microphone in the lab - left at -24.0 dBFS, right at -29.2 dBFS, each over 70 dB above the silent room. The microphone is the lab's (private config), the tones the device's (manifest); the phone's volume is set while it plays and restored. Next: its results in health and the baseline; the phone's own microphone heard the same way; a second microphone to tell left from right.
